metadata.description: Mods of the two-tier-dev system: handoff (automatic handoff + fresh context), limits (rate-limit status line).

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Writes a handoff from the live transcript past a context threshold or on /handoff, then /clear and resume.

plugins.name: limits
plugins.description: Status line with the 5h and weekly rate limits, reset countdowns, context fill and session cost.
